title: Hinomori Shizuku — Energetic On Location!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, do you remember our schedule for today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we have that meeting in the afternoon. When did you want to leave school?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we can leave after our next class ends... That should give us plenty of time to get to where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? An email...?
Oh, it's from the producer of that show we were just on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “They want to introduce us to the director of another show over lunch?” That's great! Let's see, what day would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you do all the scheduling for us, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? No, that's totally fine.
I like doing this sort of stuff, so it seems best for me to handle it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku, you've been helping plenty by taking minutes for our meetings and sharing them with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As much as I appreciate Airi saying that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for being late!
My other shoot went on longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
How many times is that now...?
I thought you asked the manager to keep this from happening.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Shizuku, is it true that you're not gonna be in our next show...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
It just happens to conflict with this live broadcast I'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As much as I want to prioritize our shows, they told me that they couldn't make any casting changes after they set this date.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: We get that work is work. Still...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't keep asking Airi to do everything...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to do more for us.)
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm finished with all of my homework...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, I need to work on this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad I found this book on how to put schedules together better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's see... “My First Schedule”...
Step 1: The Basics...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
“1. Make a complete list of all of your tasks.
2. Prioritize the most important ones or those that will take the most time...”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was still in Cheerful * Days, I never gave any of this much thought and left the manager to take care of everything...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I want to take this opportunity to learn how to put plans together and manage my time better.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't have too tight a schedule, and leave enough time between engagements since some will last longer than expected and unforeseen problems can come up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Leaving afternoons open is another trick for securing dedicated work or prep time, which can also be used to answer any sudden offers or requests...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this chapter goes into actually putting these ideas into practice... Starting by “writing down all of your plans for this week”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. For this, I can just use the schedule Airi put together for us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, wait... That would be the same as looking at the answers in the back of a textbook...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it's Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What brings you here today? It's a bit late...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
How to practice making schedules...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I tried learning what I could from a book and was going to practice making my own schedule...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I've been having a little trouble since I've already seen the one Airi made for us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you already know how the finished product looks, so it's probably hard to keep it out of your mind while you work on your own...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping to ask you all about your plans and practice making a schedule with KAITO here since he's a seasoned manager.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose I am the one to ask in this situation.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, we're actually right in the middle of preparing for a show Miku and the others are going to put on, so why don't we try thinking about the schedule for that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO, you wanted to speak with us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, I didn't know you were here. Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that you'd like to discuss with us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was just asking KAITO about how to become better at putting schedules together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And they wanna try putting one together based on the show you're about to do♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try as well. I sorta feel bad about always making you do all that stuff for us, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, I wanna learn too! It'd be great to know how to put together better practice schedules for myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
What do you say, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're welcome to join us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There are several things that I'd like to go over about your show, so could you all stick around for a bit as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's begin by listing the things that we still need to do for the show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, why don't we all give that a try on our own? Here, we can make lists using these sheets of paper.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Len & Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
Sure.
Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to learn as much as I can so that I'll be able to help Airi and the others more...)
